en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a busy interior hall, likely a conference or transport terminal. Many people in mid‑20th‑century clothing stand in queues and groups, while others sit on benches in the foreground reading or writing. A brick pillar divides the space, and in the back right there is a counter area marked with a hanging sign reading "POST" where several people are being served.
